title: 第23章 我可是明码标价来做买卖的第24章 偷窥
content_zh:
;;
超凡之上，很多大师推论还有层次，所以暂定在传说一列，只不过传说技能是怎么样的，敖鹏这个级别的内参肯定看不到。
但敖鹏几乎肯定帝国有掌握传说技能的人！
比如他自己就是其中之一。
内参继续介绍请神的方法，有了神通种子之后，最重要的就是‘土壤’，这样将神通种子种下，才能够长出神祇来。
而土壤被称为‘内景’。
内景发自于自身，人体之中有七大内景，分别对应心肝脾肺肾肠胆。
之所以会这样划分，那是因为人有七魄。
七魄常居于人身，分藏于身体七处。
尸狗居心脏，掌握理智，又看管三尸，又涉及到灵觉等要素。
伏矢居胃脏，掌握感性，内在能量转化，又影响味觉等要素。
雀阴居肾脏，掌握生育，自我恢复，又影响听觉等要素。
吞贼居肠脏，掌握防护，自我免疫，又影响触觉等要素。
非毒居胆脏，掌握力量，自我生长，又影响意觉等要素。
除秽居肝脏，掌握调节，自我平衡，又影响视觉等要素。
臭肺居肺部，掌握呼吸，外在能量转化，又影响嗅觉等要素。
魄为阴，神为阳。
请神就是以自身阴魄请阳神，从而做到阴阳调和。
而神魄所居，就在脏器之中，因此以前也有五脏庙的说法。
内景就是将自身的脏器从实体概念扩展到修行概念，通过吞食不同的灵物，借助修行之法，塑造出适合神祇居住的‘庙宇’。

就比如要搭建心庙，就需要吞食火行灵物，以火行锻造自身心脏内景。
而每个人因为自身修行不同，吞食灵物不同，所以演化的内景也不同，但总的来说，自然是吞食的灵物越好，演化的内景也越强大，越能够请到更加强大的神祇居住。
在这里内参附带了帝国能给的一种灵物参考。
黄帝祖庙灯火。
这是黄帝陵经过万民祭祀，传承了几千年的灯火，是天地间最好的火行灵物之一，全世界也只有帝国才拿得出来。
看到这里，敖鹏已经下定决心，一定要得到这种灵物！
好在祖庙灯火并非是一盏，帝国十四亿人口能够供养多少祖庙灯火敖鹏不知道，但是知道他需要尽早下手！
甚至为了获得这祖庙灯火，他不惜暴露一些自身的实力，这种东西手快有，手慢无，不知道多少人盯着。
现在游戏才两个月，帝国这种资源还很充足。
帝国愿意给，本身就是要培养游戏天才，而不是把这种资源用在废物身上！
内参研究得差不多了，敖鹏打开了游戏。
一开游戏，就看到了一条私信。
【你的好友‘小学生’完成了你委托的任务，向你提交了一件物品。】
小学生就是敖武的昵称。
敖鹏惊讶了一番，要知道他将手里面的破铜烂铁给敖武，只是一个给他香火的理由，但没想到自己弟弟居然这么争气。
这才一天的时间，竟然搞出了一件东西。
他点开物品查看。
【血锯虎头刀】
……
查看完属性，敖鹏都愣住了。
content_en:
;;
Above the extraordinary, many masters have inferred that there are still levels, so it is tentatively listed in the legendary column. However, what the legendary skills are like, Ao Peng's level of internal reference will definitely not be seen.
But Ao Peng is almost certain that there are people in the empire who master legendary skills!
For example, he himself is one of them.
The internal reference continues to introduce the method of inviting gods. After you have the magical seeds, the most important thing is the 'soil'. Only by planting the magical seeds can the gods grow.
And the soil is called the ‘interior’.
The inner scene comes from oneself. There are seven major inner scenes in the human body, corresponding to the heart, liver, spleen, lungs, kidneys, intestines and gallbladder.
The reason why they are divided like this is because humans have seven souls.
The seven souls always live in the human body and are hidden in seven places in the body.
The Corpse Dog is located in the heart, controls reason, looks after the three corpses, and is involved in spiritual awareness and other factors.
Fushiya resides in the stomach, controls sensibility, internal energy transformation, and affects taste and other factors.
Bird Yin lives in the kidneys, controls fertility, self-recovery, and affects hearing and other factors.
Swallowed thieves live in the intestines, control protection, self-immunity, and affect factors such as touch.
It is not poisonous that resides in the gallbladder, controls strength, self-growth, and affects consciousness and other factors.
In addition, the liver resides in the liver, controls regulation, self-balance, and affects vision and other factors.
Smelly lungs live in the lungs, control breathing, external energy conversion, and affect the sense of smell and other factors.
The soul is yin and the spirit is yang.
To invite the gods is to invite the yang gods with your own yin soul, so as to achieve the harmony of yin and yang.
The residence of the soul is in the internal organs, so there was also the saying of the temple of the five internal organs in the past.
The interior scene is to expand the concept of one's own organs from the physical concept to the concept of practice. By swallowing different spiritual objects and using the method of practice, a 'temple' suitable for gods to live is created.
For example, if you want to build a heart temple, you need to consume fire-element spiritual objects and use fire-element to forge the interior of your heart.
Everyone has different spiritual practices and swallows different spiritual objects, so the inner scene of evolution is also different. But in general, naturally, the better the spiritual objects they swallow, the more powerful the inner scene of evolution, and the more powerful gods can be invited to live.
The internal reference here comes with a reference to a spiritual object that the empire can provide.
Lights in the Yellow Emperor's Ancestral Temple.
This is the light of the Yellow Emperor's Mausoleum that has been sacrificed by thousands of people and has been passed down for thousands of years. It is one of the best fire spirits in the world. Only the empire can produce it.
Seeing this, Ao Peng has made up his mind to get this kind of spiritual object!
Fortunately, the ancestral temple lights are not just one. Ao Peng doesn’t know how many ancestral temple lights the empire’s population of 1.4 billion can support, but he knows that he needs to start as soon as possible!
Even in order to obtain the lights of the ancestral temple, he did not hesitate to expose some of his own strength. This kind of thing can be obtained by quick hands but not by slow hands. I don’t know how many people are watching.
The game is only two months old now, and resources like the Empire are still abundant.
The empire is willing to give, because it wants to cultivate game geniuses, rather than using this resource on waste!
The internal reference study was almost complete, and Ao Peng opened the game.
As soon as I started the game, I saw a private message.
[Your friend ‘Primary School Student’ has completed the task entrusted by you and submitted an item to you. 】
The primary school student is Ao Wu’s nickname.
Ao Peng was surprised. He had to know that he gave Ao Wu the scraps of metal in his hand just as a reason to give him incense, but he didn't expect that his brother would be so up to date.
In just one day, I actually came up with something.
He clicked on the item to examine it.
[Blood Saw Tiger Head Knife]
…
After checking the attributes, Ao Peng was stunned.
